## Où j'en suis
The SRE take-home is built and lives in its own private repo, `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home`, pushed as a subtree split so no infra history leaks. The exercise: compose (flaky-svc built from source, no prebuilt image), a renamed-metric alert rule that never fires, a connection leak, an over-broad IAM policy, a 3-hour time box, plus a rubric scored 0–3 in four areas with no cut-off. `hiring/` was removed from the infra branch but not committed, since that branch will be dropped.

- [en-cours] the removal of `hiring/` from `maya/sre-take-home` exists only in the working tree, uncommitted
- [prochaine-étape] after Thursday's 4pm call, invite Ethan as collaborator and send him the repo and README yourself
- [essai-raté] multi-arch `buildx --load` fails ("docker exporter does not currently support exporting manifest lists"), which is why compose builds from source
- [décision] no Kubernetes, 3 hours max, terraform + compose only (source: t03)
- [décision] no pass threshold; scores are input, Noa is second reviewer (source: t10)
- [décision] exercise in its own private repo, delete from infra branch, no PR (source: t14)
